question: An oncoming vehicle continues to display its turn signal and approaches the intersection without slowing down. What should you do?
options: (1) Slow down first and proceed only after confirming it is safe.
(2) Honk or flash your lights to remind the vehicle to let you pass first.
(3) Vehicles going straight have priority; assume the other vehicle will yield to me.
correct_answer: (1) Slow down first and proceed only after confirming it is safe.
explanation: Official Taiwan THB Hazard Perception Video #202601. Defensive Driving Rule: Always anticipate potential hazards, slow down at intersections, and maintain safe following distance.
